resources.string: Catch your dreams before they fade.
Set your alarm. When you wake up, just talk. Remnant captures your dreams before they slip away.
Remnant greets you by name each morning, so it needs one first.
Your phone already rings at %1$s. Remnant won\'t ring over it -- it will stay quiet and ask about your dream at %2$s, which is a while after you\'re up.

Your morning voice is made by Google\'s text-to-speech service: your first name and the greeting are sent to Google to generate it. Tap to hear the others, or pick your phone\'s own voice to keep it on your device.
Remnant sends nothing to make it

Cloud voices are made by Google\'s text-to-speech service, and one is set up for you. Using one sends your first name and the greeting text to Google to generate the audio -- nothing else, and no dream content ever. Choose your phone\'s own voice and Remnant makes no text-to-speech request at all.
Take a moment\u2026 what do you remember?
Your alarm will ask what you dreamed about.\nJust talk. We\'ll handle the rest.
